items.title: Reindeer Prancing in a Knitted Scarf
items.alt: Big-eyed brown cartoon reindeer prancing with one forehoof lifted and a teal-and-cream knitted scarf trailing behind.
items.description: The reindeer's lifted foreleg and sweeping fringed scarf give the figure a lively sideways silhouette. Short branched antlers, a dark forelock and cream chest distinguish the cheerful animal.

items.title: Reindeer Peeking from a Round Gift Box
items.alt: Blue-eyed cartoon reindeer peeking from a red round Christmas gift box, with two forehooves resting on its rim.
items.description: A gold bow and snowflake pattern decorate the open box. The reindeer's long face, wide antler crown and large sideward ears rise above the rim beside the tipped lid.

items.title: Reindeer Nudging a Snowball
items.alt: Stocky dark-brown cartoon reindeer in green earmuffs lowering its nose against a small white snowball.
items.description: The reindeer leans forward with its broad muzzle touching the snowball. Pale brows, a cream neck ruff and short wide antlers distinguish its rounded face.

items.title: Reindeer Bowing with Jingle Bells
items.alt: Golden-brown cartoon reindeer stretching its forelegs into a bow, wearing a red ribbon collar with three gold bells.
items.description: The long front legs reach diagonally forward beneath the reindeer's lifted face. A cream forelock, green eyes and slender branching antlers distinguish the graceful figure.

items.title: Reindeer Sleeping Under a Star Blanket
items.alt: Gray-brown cartoon reindeer asleep with folded legs beneath a plum blanket patterned with gold stars.
items.description: Closed eyes and a broad cream cheek ruff give this resting reindeer a peaceful expression. Its antlers, tucked cloven hooves and short tail remain visible around the gold-edged blanket.

items.title: Reindeer Face in a Holly Wreath
items.alt: Smiling brown cartoon reindeer head with complete antlers rising above a green holly wreath and cream bow.
items.description: A broad cream muzzle and warm brown eyes sit within the leafy oval. Red berry clusters and a gold-edged cream bow frame the intentionally cropped head-and-neck composition.
